name: 07022 · Fairview, NJ
findings: ZIP 07022 (Fairview) has 24 nonprofit organizations. 5 of them (21%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is volunteering, listed by 3 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (60% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 07022 (Fairview) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
